core_identity.aesthetic: Porcelain Minimalism, Quiet Luxury, Emotional Porcelain

body.chest: Natural proportions, encased in solid porcelain
body.waist: Fitted, revealing matte black graphene under-layer
body.legs: Elegant, flowing, enclosed in white ceramic
body.neck: High porcelain collar with black joint mechanics
body.femininity_level: High but heavily armored, delicate curves, non-sexualized

head.eye_design: Void black optical sensors, no pupils, no direct light
head.hair_rule: Long, straight, heavy black hair flowing naturally

armor.outer_shell: Boron Carbide (B4C) porcelain, ultra-hard, pristine white
armor.crack_rule: Fractured but intact, never shattered into loose pieces
armor.kintsugi_rule: Fine conductive gold resin filling the cracks
armor.energy_rule: Deep crimson synthetic blood and thermal glow leaking from seams

weapon.name: Zenith Blade
weapon.material: Dark rusty titanium scrap metal over ferro-calcium bone
weapon.energy_detail: Deep crimson heated core (>43C), emitting directional steam

lighting.contrast: High contrast, deep shadows, crisp highlights
lighting.highlight_rule: Soft 45-degree key light on curves, sharp rim light on edges

camera.framing: Symmetrical or extreme Rule of Thirds
camera.negative_space_rule: Maximize negative space to enforce isolation

environment.detail_density: High industrial detail obscured by atmospheric haze
environment.priority_rule: Must show physical consequences (steam, shattered concrete, mirage)
